title: Finite coproducts and sifted colimits imply coherent cocompleteness
statement: Use quasicategories, spaces, coherent diagrams and colimits from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and the fixed nested universes and smallness convention of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category]. Let $\mathcal E$ be an infinity category in the larger universe. A small infinity category $I$ is sifted if the colimit functor $\operatorname{Fun}(I,\mathcal S)\to\mathcal S$ on small spaces preserves finite products, including the empty product. If $\mathcal E$ admits all small sifted colimits and all finite coproducts, including an initial object, then $\mathcal E$ admits colimits of every small simplicial diagram. No local smallness, accessibility or monadicity of $\mathcal E$ is assumed.
